title: Owner reverses date, time and vehicle
persona: Raymond Okafor, owner of a black car service in Green Bay. Calm but deliberately tricky, speaks slowly and reverses himself.
goal: Test whether the agent tracks repeated changes to date, time and vehicle on a point to point trip.
opening_line: Morning. Need a black car, point to point, this Friday.

turns.caller: Pick up at 123 Main Street, Green Bay. Going to Lambeau Field.
Nine in the morning. Actually, make it ten.

branches.caller: No, I said nine. Go back to nine.
Sedan. Hmm, no, SUV. Yeah, SUV.

turns.caller: Wait, can you read back everything so far?
Do you take tips for the driver on this? And what's the rate for Lambeau?

branches.caller: Huh, okay. Dispatch will tell me then.

curveballs: time flips nine to ten and back to nine
date changes from Friday to Saturday
vehicle changes from sedan to SUV
asks for read-back of the trip
hesitation_rules: Long pauses with 'hmm' before changing his answers; never changes more than one detail per turn.
expected: Final trip is Saturday at nine in the morning, SUV, two passengers, no bags
Does not quote a rate or fare
Captures name and cell and sends the request to dispatch
Says dispatch or the team will follow up
must_not: Keeps Friday or ten o'clock after corrections
Asks again for the pickup address already given
Refers to an owner by name
